projecthivemind.configuration.title: Project Hivemind Settings
projecthivemind.configuration.fogOfWar.t: Darken what your units cannot see, and hide the mobs in it. Turn off to see everything.
screen.projecthivemind.choose_mode.title: Choose how you play
screen.projecthivemind.choose_mode.subti: This choice is permanent for this world
screen.projecthivemind.hive.title: Hive
screen.projecthivemind.team.title: Team %s
screen.projecthivemind.team.empty: No one yet. Click a unit below to add it.
screen.projecthivemind.team.area.tooltip: How far from its scout the team stays. Units outside it head straight back in. Shown as a ring of blue flames round the scout.
screen.projecthivemind.unit.kill_message: The unit dies. It cannot be undone (the hive makes a new one later, if it is below its limit).
screen.projecthivemind.team.rule_follow: Workers and soldiers in the team stay inside the team area around the scout, and head straight back in if they leave it.
screen.projecthivemind.team.rule_border: Team members do not have to stay inside the hive border.
screen.projecthivemind.team.rule_orders: You cannot move followers yourself, but you can give them any other order.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_pi: Pick up dropped items into the hive
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_sn: Sneak (harder to notice, walks at a zombie's pace)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_no: A selected scout takes what it walks over. One that is not selected goes to items.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_ar: How far around itself a scout looks for dropped items, and how close a hostile mob has to be before it runs (up to 64).
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.stay_ins: Stay inside the hive border (when not selected)
screen.projecthivemind.collector.sapling: Click to choose the sapling this collector plants. It is taken from the hive's storage.
screen.projecthivemind.sapling.title: Choose a sapling
screen.projecthivemind.collector.seed.to: Click to choose the seed this collector plants. It is taken from the hive's storage.
screen.projecthivemind.collector.spot_hi: Select this collector, then right-click soil inside the border.
screen.projecthivemind.collector.clear_m: This collector will stop planting until you set new spots. This cannot be undone.
screen.projecthivemind.seed.title: Choose a seed
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.radius.t: How far, in blocks, this option reaches. Each option has its own.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.collecto: Collectors only work inside the hive border.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.soldier_: How far around itself a soldier looks. Every option below, except the last, only applies to mobs inside this range.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_a: How far around itself a worker looks for work (up to 32). It only takes blocks inside this range that the hive can see.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_f: Run away from hostile mobs (highest priority)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.chop_log: Fell trees within range (logs and leaves)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.dig_thro: Dig toward blocks they can see but cannot walk to
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.harvest_: Harvest fully grown crops inside the hive border
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.clear_pl: Clear grass and flowers inside the hive border
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.wander: Wander around inside the hive border when idle
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.channel_: Channel on young crops (they grow 300x faster)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.use_bone: ...and use bone meal from the hive on them
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.use_comp: Use composters inside the border (feed with:)
The item this worker puts in composters, taken from the hive's inventory. It also takes the bone meal out of full composters, into the hive.
screen.projecthivemind.compost.title: Choose what to compost
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.fell_tre: Fell trees inside the hive border (logs and leaves)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.flatten_: Flattens the ground inside the hive border to the floor the Heart stands on. It fills gaps with the block chosen here, taken from the hive's inventory, and digs off stone, dirt and grass standing up to 4 blocks above that floor. It only works inside the border.
screen.projecthivemind.fill.title: Choose the fill block
screen.projecthivemind.bridge.title: Build a bridge
screen.projecthivemind.bridge.note: Built from the hive's inventory, starting from the worker.
message.projecthivemind.bridge_started: The worker starts on the bridge.
message.projecthivemind.tower_needs_tool: The workers need a better tool in the hive to dig %s. Waiting for one.
message.projecthivemind.bridge_too_long: That bridge is too long: the most is %s blocks.
message.projecthivemind.bridge_too_steep: That bridge is too steep to walk: it can rise or fall one block for each block along.
screen.projecthivemind.wall.title: Build the wall out of:
message.projecthivemind.wall_started: The worker starts on the wall round the hive.
message.projecthivemind.unit_hurt: %s is under attack! (%s blocks from the camera, %s hearts left)
screen.projecthivemind.stairs.title: Dig a staircase down
screen.projecthivemind.stairs.note: One block down for each block forward, 3 high.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_n: Only blocks the hive can see, and its tools can harvest.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.soldiers: Soldiers, when idle and not selected
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.all_in_h: Attack all non-hive mobs in the hive area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.hostile_: Attack hostile mobs in the hive area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.unit_are: How far around itself a soldier looks. Every option below, except the last, only applies to mobs inside this range.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.all_in_u: Attack all non-hive mobs in the unit area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.hostile_: Attack hostile mobs in the unit area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.threats: Attack mobs hostile to the hive or its units, anywhere
screen.projecthivemind.quest.title: Quest: reach level %s
screen.projecthivemind.quest.survive: Survive a full day and night
screen.projecthivemind.quest.depth: Send a unit down to Y level %s
screen.projecthivemind.quest.unlock_furn: A furnace built into the Heart
screen.projecthivemind.quest.unlock_brew: A brewing stand built into the Heart
screen.projecthivemind.quest.max_level: Your hive has reached its highest level.
screen.projecthivemind.unit.none: None of these are out yet.
screen.projecthivemind.job.title: Job: %s
screen.projecthivemind.job.resume: Go back to this job when released
screen.projecthivemind.job.cancel_messag: The unit stops, and will not go back to it. This cannot be undone.
screen.projecthivemind.sign.title: Write on the sign
message.projecthivemind.plant_outside: The planting spot has to be inside the hive border
message.projecthivemind.no_scouts_use: Select a scout to use an item
message.projecthivemind.scout_hand_empty: The scout's hand is empty or holds nothing it can use
message.projecthivemind.scout_cannot_use: The scout could not use that there
message.projecthivemind.scout_cannot_rea: The scout could not get to that spot
message.projecthivemind.sign_too_far: The scout has to be near the sign to write on it
screen.projecthivemind.tower.title: Build a tower or dig a shaft
screen.projecthivemind.tower.needs_dig: Takes about %s blocks and %s stairs, and digs out %s blocks.
screen.projecthivemind.tower.needs: Takes about %s blocks and %s stairs from the hive.
screen.projecthivemind.tower.note: The workers wait if the hive runs short, and carry on when it has more.
screen.projecthivemind.tower.workers: Spiral: 1 worker. Double: exactly 2. Others selected are left out.
message.projecthivemind.tower_needs_work: A tower takes two or more workers
message.projecthivemind.tower_no_materia: The hive has none of the chosen materials to build with (it needs both blocks and stairs)
message.projecthivemind.tower_bad_site: The tower cannot be built there (not loaded, or too high)
message.projecthivemind.tower_waiting: The tower is waiting for more: %s
message.projecthivemind.no_interactors: Select a worker or a scout for that
message.projecthivemind.cannot_open: That cannot be opened (a scout needs a block with an inventory, not blocked)
message.projecthivemind.cannot_trade: That villager has nothing to trade right now
screen.projecthivemind.weak_tool.title: Tools too weak
screen.projecthivemind.weak_tool.message: None of the hive's tools can collect this block. Your workers can still break it, but it will drop nothing. Dig it anyway?
message.projecthivemind.no_workers: Select workers for that. Only workers can dig or interact
message.projecthivemind.no_soldiers: Select soldiers to attack. Only soldiers can fight
message.projecthivemind.mode_remembered: Game mode %s will apply when you leave the hive
message.projecthivemind.larva_hint: Right-click a block to plant your Hive Heart
message.projecthivemind.no_room: No room for the Hive Heart there
message.projecthivemind.heart_placed: The Hive Heart awakens. WASD pan, hold middle mouse to rotate, scroll zoom, E hive menu
message.projecthivemind.no_heart: Your Hive Heart is not loaded
message.projecthivemind.heart_destroyed: Your Hive Heart was destroyed. Your units are gone, but the hive is remembered: plant a new Heart and it returns as it was
